global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (full background), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (highlighted headline line, arrow and CTA), pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary for this variation: muted cool gray #8A8790 for the dull veil of the before side, warm rose-gold #FFB3D1 glow for the light lines.
global_identity.visual_style: Photorealistic split-screen body ad, real skin and real fabrics, with a graphic light-line overlay on the after side; the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Intense, energetic and confident; deep plum background with a soft fuchsia glow.
global_identity.graphic_language: Thin white vertical divider, curved pink arrow, glowing thin light lines following the leg muscles, a short pink underline stroke and a wide pill button.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in very heavy condensed geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase, second line taller; subtitle in rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins Bold look), uppercase.

creative_objective: Speak to women who train legs and see no change: make the 'invisible' missing support visible (dull gray veil vs glowing pink light lines on toned legs), with a mechanism headline and a clear CTA, keeping the exact F35 structure.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the dull legs vs the glowing legs, 2) the 2-line headline, 3) the subtitle with the segment, 4) the CTA pill, 5) the bottle.
art_direction.composition_style: Image fills the whole canvas, split in two by a thin white vertical line; bottom-left 55% holds the text stack over the before side; bottom-right holds the bottle over the after legs.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Top 65% pure image with no text; bottom 35% text stack aligned left with clear spacing between headline, subtitle, stroke, CTA and registration line.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Studio light from the front-top; before side flat and desaturated, after side warmer with a soft glow from the light lines; bottle with a crisp contact shadow and a fuchsia rim light; bottom of the canvas darkened for text readability.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Full-canvas photo on a deep plum background, split by a thin white vertical line in the center. Left: a woman's legs from behind, waist to ankles, in gray leggings, covered by a dull gray translucent veil. Right: the same woman's legs on another day in black biker shorts, toned, with thin glowing rose-pink light lines following the curve of the glutes and the leg muscles. A curved bubblegum-pink arrow sits at the middle height between them. Bottom-left (55% width): 2-line headline (second line bubblegum pink and taller), 2-line uppercase subtitle with the segment highlighted in pink, a short pink stroke, a wide bubblegum-pink CTA pill, and one thin small registration line under it. Bottom-right: the real bottle standing over the after legs.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 photorealistic split-screen supplement ad on a deep plum #2B1226 background with a soft fuchsia #E6177F glow. The image fills the whole canvas and is split in two by a thin white vertical line in the exact center; no text at all in the top 65%. LEFT HALF (before): a real Latina woman's legs photographed from behind, from the waist down to the ankles, slim and flat glutes, wearing heather-gray leggings, standing barefoot; a dull, desaturated gray translucent veil lies over her glutes and thighs, making the zone look flat, tired and lifeless. RIGHT HALF (after): the same woman on another day, from the same height and framing, wearing black biker shorts, a slightly different relaxed stance, glutes visibly rounder and lifted and thighs more toned; thin glowing rose-pink light lines with small bright dots trace the curve of the glutes and run down the thigh muscles like energy, elegant and subtle. A curved bubblegum-pink #FF8CC0 arrow points from left to right at mid height. Tasteful, sporty, non-explicit; nothing grotesque, no mud, no veins, no medical details. BOTTOM 35%, the bottom edge is darkened to plum for readability. Bottom-left (about 55% width), aligned left: the 2-line headline in very heavy condensed uppercase sans-serif, line 1 white, line 2 bubblegum pink and taller; under it a 2-line uppercase white subtitle where the segment words are in bubblegum pink; a short bubblegum-pink brush stroke; a wide bubblegum-pink pill button with dark plum text; and under the pill one thin line of small white text with the registration. Bottom-right, standing over the after legs, the real product bottle, upright and razor sharp, about one third of the canvas height: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle; black label with the small pink VITALABH emblem, the huge bold white word 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', the small line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra', a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' joined by plus signs, and '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)'. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Crisp contact shadow and a fuchsia rim light on the bottle. Do not add a logo, price, offer box, icons, stars or any extra text.
